not a field-battle unit (fights_in_main_phase = no for most) -> skip or spawn as crew
handgun -> substitute crossbow (no firearms in vanilla Bannerlord)

levy.base_type_equivalent: none (levies are not a MaA base type; countered as peasant-ish infantry)

knights.formula_note: Knight combat damage = prowess * KNIGHT_DAMAGE_PER_PROWESS * (1 + knight_effectiveness_mult); toughness = prowess * KNIGHT_TOUGHNESS_PER_PROWESS (engine-side; formula INFERRED from define comments).

hired_troops.note: No script definitions for mercenary companies exist in common/ (spawned by code per culture, sized by NMercenary). Hired MaA picks are steered by allowed_in_hired_troops / hired_stack_size / mercenary_fallback / fallback_in_hired_troops_if_unlocked / holy_order_fallback on MaA types, and religion holy_order_maa lists. In a battle, hired regiments are visible via every_army_maa_regiment (include_hired = yes default) and is_hired_maa_regiment.

codegen_keys.note: Ordered key lists for generating CK3 if/else_if emission chains (CK3 script cannot print a MaA/culture key directly as data; test each key). Trigger syntax VERIFIED in logs/triggers.log (script_docs, CK3 1.20).

innovation_repeating_crossbow.potential: trigger_if = { limit = { has_dlc = "All Under Heaven" } OR = { this = culture:tangut has_cultural_parameter = unlock_shenbigong_innovation } } trigger_else = { OR = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_chinese this = culture:tangut } }

innovation_pole_vault.potential: OR = { this = culture:guanches any_parent_culture_or_above = { this = culture:guanches } }

innovation_rocket_cart.potential: has_tgp_dlc_trigger = yes OR = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_chinese has_cultural_pillar = heritage_korean has_cultural_pillar = heritage_buyeo }
